rows.evidence: GasCitySabotage 44.0.2: SabotageMission (P15, the only trigger whose code reaches the countdown) calls P5 in its first run slice (state 2, readable L2899-2903), and P5 SETGLOBALs hackTime = modeTimer x Lerp(1.8, 1.2, difficulty) (P5 i105 GETIMPORT modeTimer, i112 SETGLOBAL hackTime, L1088-1094). The countdown reader P3 (i59 SetObjTimer(hackTime), i33/i36 host-migration restore) runs at stage 5 through P12 or after a host migration through P4, after many yields. So the R10 row (entry write of hackTime) never reached a reader: P5 overwrites it first (WRONG OWNER). Two engine-write orders are possible and are not separated offline: without a later engine write the countdown is modeTimer x factor (SabotageMission trigger: _modeTimer=60); with an engine re-write of the parameters before stage 5 it is the level hackTime (10). Scaling both parameters by the same factor scales the countdown in both orders. Levels: 12 triggers carry _hackTime=10; _modeTimer is 60 on the one SabotageMission trigger and 100 on the 11 others (GasStormTarget, TurbineExplosion, ShutterDrop, Left/RightSideGasRoom), which never run P3 or P5.
